title: No BG value on wear complication with "640G / Eversence" as HW Data source
symptom: When using the patched Dexcom G6 App, BG values go to AAPS and AAPS broadcasts it back to Xdrip when using "640G / Eversence" as HW Data source. On Wear complication, there is no BG shown (NULL NULL ()) in this particular case, otherwise wear complication works.
evidence_quote: On Wear complication, there is no BG shown (NULL NULL ()) in this particiliar case (otherwise wear complication works).
